minutes.headline: Board withheld a recommendation on the Tilton Ave sewer article and questioned a resident's plan to add a firefighter.
minutes.summary: The Select Board previewed Town Meeting articles: the Hickory Hills dam easement, adding Tilton Ave to the sewer service area, and repeal of the cigarette rolling paper ban. A resident proposed a floor amendment to fund an extra EMS firefighter for 24/7 coverage, and the town manager and some members objected to changing the plan at Town Meeting. The board then heard the town manager's report and held a workshop on the future of five town buildings.

what_happened.line: The Select Board withheld a recommendation on Article 25, which would add Tilton Ave to the sewer service area, after a long discussion.
A resident proposed a floor amendment to add an EMS firefighter for 24/7 coverage, paid by redirecting savings from fire truck borrowing; the town manager and some members objected.
The board moved to recommend repeal of the cigarette rolling paper chapter and to pass over articles 27 and 28; the minutes record the votes as not audible.
The board moved to set the stormwater task force at one member each from three boards, plus two alternates; the vote was not audible.
A workshop on the future of five town buildings ended with consensus direction, and a member offered to turn the recommendations into a graphic.

why_it_matters: The Tilton Ave article and the firefighter amendment both go to Town Meeting, where residents vote on sewer service area and on whether to change staffing and borrowing plans on the floor.
Moving money from fire truck borrowing to a hire changes what is paid now versus what is borrowed, so the effect reaches the tax bill and fire and EMS coverage.
The building workshop points toward a recommendation on town offices and other facilities that residents will later be asked to weigh.
watch_next: Next week's agenda: the Open Meeting Law determination and an open goals review, with a reorganization meeting proposed for the first June meeting.
A joint meeting with the Finance Committee after Town Meeting on taxes and the two and a half percent assumption.
